newsitem.title: USA: Nui sees merger as immediately accretive.
newsitem.headline: Nui sees merger as immediately accretive.

text.p: NUI Corp said on Monday that it had closed its acquisition of 49 percent of privately-owned TIC Enterprises Inc and that it expected the acquisition to be immediately accretive to earnings.

Based on TIC's strong profit growth in the first quarter, Nui said, "the transaction is expected to add about $.04 per share to NUI's fiscal year 1997 earnings and $.04 - $.06 per share to fiscal year 1998 net earnings."

TIC recorded net income of $1.2 million for the first quarter ended March 31, nearly as much as the $1.3 million in net income from continuing operations that TIC recorded for the entire year of 1996, NUI said in a statement.

Under the agreement, NUI paid TIC $22 million in cash for its 49 percent interest in TIC. NUI currently plans to issue common stock in September to pay down the short-term debt incurred to finance the closing of the transaction, NUI said.
NUI Corp, based in Bedminster, NJ, is a gas distribution, sales and service company.
TIC, based in Georgia, specializes in sales and marketing outsourcing.
